**Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse** is a healthcare cluster operating within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] in Denmark [^src5]. It is systematically monitored in the national clinical quality improvement programs for [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] (AFDK), which are managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut [^src7]. The cluster's performance is evaluated across a wide range of clinical quality indicators, including anticoagulation treatment coverage, diagnostic echocardiography, bleeding incidents, heart failure development, and mortality rates [^src1] [^src3] [^src6].

In terms of specific clinical outcomes, Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse achieved a 93.4% result for Indikator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients [^src2]. The cluster is also tracked for its incidence of ischemic stroke (apopleksi) among atrial fibrillation patients, as visualized in national geographic distributions (Danmarkskort) for [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] [^src4]. Furthermore, the cluster's data is regularly benchmarked against regional and national averages to identify variations in clinical practice and patient outcomes, such as 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year treatment coverage, waiting times for anticoagulation, and severe bleeding events [^src1] [^src5] [^src8] [^src10] [^src11].
